# Siddharth Sah

> Personal website of Siddharth Sah, a Senior AI Engineer in Singapore. He builds agentic AI for smart factories at Panasonic AI — multi-agent systems that plan, monitor, and act on real production lines. Previously at Prudential AI Lab. His work spans computer vision, NLP, machine learning, and data science.

He grew up in Darbhanga, India. Off hours he ships open-source AI tools, runs a homelab, and volunteers fixing appliances at Repair Kopitiam in Singapore. Recognition includes the World Summit Award for Young Innovators (presented in Lisbon by Portugal's Minister of Science for BioP, a 3D bioprinter he built) and a $25,000 win in Lockheed Martin's C-130J RO-RO Challenge.

## Pages

- [Home](https://siddharthksah.github.io/): who he is, what he builds, recognition, and background
- [Blog](https://siddharthksah.github.io/blog/): notes on applied AI engineering — new posts in progress
- [RSS feed](https://siddharthksah.github.io/feed.xml): Atom feed of blog posts

## Projects

- [SnapOtter](https://snapotter.com): open-source self-hosted file-processing platform — 200+ tools with local AI (OCR, transcription, upscaling), no cloud required
- [DeepSafe](https://github.com/siddharthksah/DeepSafe): open-source deepfake detection — 21 models behind one API
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/siddharthksah): all public repositories
